articles.title: Welcome to Jupiter: The Giant That Could Have Been a Star!
articles.summary: Did you know Jupiter is so big it could swallow 1,300 Earths? This gas giant has a storm called the Great Red Spot that's been raging for centuries. And one of its moons might hide an ocean with alien life!

articles.title: Canada: The Country That's Bigger Than Your Whole Weekend!
articles.summary: Canada is the second biggest country on Earth, but it has fewer people than Tokyo! From polar bears to French-speaking cities, this land is full of surprises. Did you know it has 20% of the world's fresh water?

articles.title: The Actor Who Felt Like an Outsider—Just Like Mozart!
articles.summary: Will Sharpe plays Mozart in a new show, and he knows what it's like to feel different. Growing up between Japan and England, he never quite fit in. Now he uses that feeling to bring the quirky genius to life.
